name: n8n-knowledge
description: Auto-recalls n8n documentation and community knowledge when working on n8n projects. Powered by a Hindsight graph memory database with 315+ pages of official n8n docs.

enableAutoRecall.title: Enable Auto-Recall
enableAutoRecall.description: Automatically recall n8n docs when n8n-related terms are detected. Disable to use manual recall only (saves tokens).

showRecallResults.title: Show Recall Results
showRecallResults.description: When enabled, Claude cites the knowledge base as a source in its responses. When disabled, Claude uses the context silently without mentioning where the information came from. Note: the raw injected context is only visible in the conversation transcript, not in the chat UI.

enableWorkflowValidation.title: Enable Workflow Validation
enableWorkflowValidation.description: Experimental plugin-side validation after Claude writes or edits workflow JSON files. Injects validator feedback back into the turn. Disabled by default.

workflowValidationMaxCalls.title: Workflow Validation Max Calls
workflowValidationMaxCalls.description: Max plugin-side validator calls per session when workflow validation is enabled.

enableBackstopRecall.title: Enable Backstop Recall
enableBackstopRecall.description: Refresh n8n context during agent reasoning (after Edit/Write/Task). Disable to save tokens.

backstopRecallMaxTokens.title: Backstop Recall Max Tokens
backstopRecallMaxTokens.description: Returned-context size cap per backstop recall.

backstopRecallBudget.title: Backstop Recall Budget
backstopRecallBudget.description: Hindsight recall effort: low, mid, or high.

enableSubagentInjection.title: Inject Context Into Subagents (WIP — do not enable)
enableSubagentInjection.description: WORK IN PROGRESS — UNTESTED. Prepends n8n context into Task subagent prompts via the PreToolUse updatedInput mechanism, which has NOT been verified at runtime. Leave OFF: enabling it is unsupported and may not work or may interfere with subagent prompts until a future release verifies it.

triggerKeywords.title: Trigger Keywords
triggerKeywords.description: Comma list of broad n8n trigger keywords used in n8n codebases. Use the token DEFAULTS to include the built-ins (workflow, node, trigger, webhook, credential, expression, execution). Example: 'DEFAULTS, mynode'. Leave blank for defaults.

debugRecall.title: Debug Recall
debugRecall.description: Show injected context in your terminal. 'summary' shows a truncated preview, 'full' shows everything the harness receives, 'off' hides output.

validatorMode.title: Validator Mode
validatorMode.description: Plugin-side validator routing only. Choose 'local', 'cloud', or 'default'. 'default' prefers a local n8n-mcp install and falls back to the cloud validator URL. This setting is not for the eval harness MCP/bare conditions or local post-hoc validation scripts.

validatorCloudUrl.title: Validator Cloud URL
validatorCloudUrl.description: Plugin-side validator endpoint URL, for example https://your-host/public/validate-workflow. Not used by MCP/bare eval conditions or local post-hoc validation scripts.

validatorLocalPath.title: Validator Local Path
validatorLocalPath.description: Optional plugin-side override for the local n8n-mcp install root. Leave blank to auto-detect the default ~/.npm/_npx/.../node_modules/n8n-mcp location. Not used by MCP/bare eval conditions or local post-hoc validation scripts.
